project.name: ClassGraph benchmark corpus
project.description:
Not part of the ClassGraph build. This pom exists only to download a fixed set of jars to scan, so that the memory mapping benchmark scans the same bytes on every operating system. Populate the corpus with:
mvn -f benchmark/pom.xml dependency:copy-dependencies -DoutputDirectory=benchmark/corpus
These versions are a measurement fixture: nothing is compiled or run against them, they are only scanned. Leave them out of routine dependency sweeps, because changing them changes what the benchmark scans, and the corpus figures quoted on the "Memory mapping benchmark" wiki page are the ones a particular set of pins produced. Bumping for a published CVE is still worth doing; when that happens, the corpus is no longer the one those figures describe, so say so on that page.
